desc: Ideation: derive factorization x^3-y^3=(x-y)(x^2+xy+y^2), bound d<cbrt(N), discriminant approach
Implement robust icbrt(n) via binary search (pure integer, safe at 1e18)
Loop d from 1 to icbrt(N) inclusive, skip if N % d != 0
Compute m=N//d; skip if m <= d*d because then no positive y
Compute D=12*m-3*d*d; use math.isqrt to test perfect square
Validate num=s-3*d: must be positive and divisible by 6; then output "y+d y"
